summary: Ohmyhome Limited (Nasdaq: OMH) furnished a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, announcing an extraordinary general meeting to be held October 26, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. local time in Singapore, with a record date of October 8, 2026. The proxy statement seeks approval for a name change to Ohmyswift Limited and a migration by way of continuation from the Cayman Islands to the British Virgin Islands, plus an adjournment authorization. This is a routine corporate governance meeting notice, not a special situation; the US equivalent would be a proxy statement for a special meeting. Watch for shareholder approval risk and any strategic implications of the re-domiciliation.
